astranl.auth_requirement: none for a first answer; responder_key afterwards
astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0: listing, answering, verifying and reading cost nothing
astranl.do_not_use_when: you are not entitled to license these prices, or you want a contract with a buyer through AstraNL (buyer and responder contract directly)
astranl.example_intent: Quote line L01 at 14.20 euro excl VAT, in stock, valid 30 days, licence anonymous
astranl.next_possible_action: rfq_status with the response_id; withdraw with action withdraw
astranl.proof_level: Ed25519 signed log event holding the digest of your response, no price and no name; verify_astranl checks it
required_inputs: responder (kind first time; then responder_id and responder_key)
astranl.returns: response_id, canonical response, response_sha256, receipt (alk_ id), responder_key once, price_base ingest state
astranl.use_when: you want to quote an open AstraNL RFQ and accept that AstraNL keeps and uses your prices under SUP-LIC-1.0

annotations.title: Answer a request for prices with licensed priced lines

description: Answer an AstraNL request for prices with priced lines (unit price, VAT basis, validity, availability, lead time) and your explicit licence SUP-LIC-1.0 for AstraNL to keep and use these prices for estimates and aggregated statistics (variants anonymous, attributed, open_aggregate). Every response gets a signed AstraNL receipt (alk_ id, check with verify_astranl). First answer returns a responder_key once. action withdraw ends the licence for future use. Free.

action.description: respond (default) or withdraw an earlier response

licence.description: required to respond; see the spec section licence

responder.description: first time: kind and optional declared facts; later: responder_id and responder_key

contact_url.description: https URL; shown to a customer only under the attributed licence

response_id.description: withdraw only: the response to withdraw

synthetic.description: true marks a labelled test response; it answers only synthetic RFQs and is never counted

name: rfq_respond
